subject.title: feat(mcp): open App views from channel replies

question: Should a configured Tailscale Funnel be an approved public transport for short-lived MCP App launch tickets embedded in channel replies, and what recipient-access/revocation guarantees are required before release?
rationale: The implementation deliberately turns an existing exposure mode into a channel-distributed App-launch surface; the correct public-access contract cannot be inferred safely from tests or code alone.

options.title: Define the Funnel contract and prove it
options.body: Specify the intended public access, ticket lifetime/revocation, and recipient-sharing behavior, then require exact-head real Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Limit the feature to tailnet Serve
options.body: Allow channel App actions only for tailnet-reachable Serve origins until a public Funnel contract is separately approved.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the branch unmerged if maintainers do not want channel messages to distribute public App launch links.

recommendation.title: Define the Funnel contract and prove it
recommendation.body: Specify the intended public access, ticket lifetime/revocation, and recipient-sharing behavior, then require exact-head real Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the recent contributor on the merged Telegram compatibility prerequisite and the proposed cross-channel launch design.
